ab_drive.case: position opened 10 bars ago, opened_at only, flat bars
ab_drive.direction: treatment fires the designed 5-bar time exit the control never fires

decision_record.calculation: Fixture: opened_at 10 bars before the latest close, no bars_held, flat bars. Baseline exits 0 (held read as 0), treatment exits 1 at the designed 5-bar deadline. bars_held present: identical decisions under both rules (2 -> hold, 5 -> exit).
decision_record.comparison: Frozen baseline: time exit consumed only the bars_held field. Comparator: same bars/position, held count derived from opened_at (bars closing after the open).
decision_record.experiment: Paired A/B in tests/test_edge_batch6_blockers.py; rejection rule = derived count disagreeing with an explicit bars_held field, or any entry decision change (entry qty pinned 476 both rules).
decision_record.mechanism: Information (volume shock) with a time-based exit; the leak is a missing designed exit — positions whose journal row carries opened_at but no bars_held could only exit on a bearish spike, i.e. unbounded holding of a 5-bar trade.
decision_record.transfer: Volume-spike momentum on LINK: the sleeve supplies immediacy into a genuine volume shock; the designed holding period is 5 bars, after which the shock information is stale.
